endpoint: codex exec (Codex CLI headless) with hosted web_search

freshness_overlay.brief_suffix: Only use sources published on or after {{AFTER_DATE}}.

query_transform_notes: Codex writes its own queries. 'cached' (default) reads an OpenAI-maintained index without external access; 'live' is for tasks that depend on current information.
cost_model: No published per-call price; operator proxy $0.005/search (price-table 2026-09-30) + model tokens of the pinned Codex model.

cli flags.note: '-c key=value' override syntax and 'codex exec' are from prior use, not re-read on 2026-11-11; the config reference documents the keys (web_search, tools.web_search{context_size,allowed_domains,location}).

model.note: Reader is the Codex model, not the fixed extractor, unless the extractor is an OpenAI model Codex can pin.

docs.supports: web_search disabled|cached|indexed|live (default cached; live under full access); tools.web_search object; deprecated features.* toggles
mode semantics, allow-lists, hosted tool ignores sandbox network rules

rationale.web_search: 'live' so freshness matches other arms that fetch live; cached index may lag.
rationale.context_size: 'high' gives the model the most search context (documented option low|medium|high).
